events.title: "Imagine" Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on October 1, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51st
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an album that still resonates today. What's your favourite track from this timeless masterpiece?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician, singer-songwriter, and actor Sting celebrates his 75th birthday.

angles.name: Sting 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his solo career, his music has been a constant. What's your favourite Sting or Police track?

events.title: Original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod 25th
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer that put 1,000 songs in your pocket. How many did you own?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon 86th
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese 87th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your go-to track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. Which track takes you back?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who was 40 years old.

angles.name: Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been David Bowie's 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to The King, Elvis Presley! His music still shakes, rattles, and rolls us. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83rd
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are legendary. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82nd
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice has given us countless hits. Which Rod song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! From 'Our House' to 'Baggy Trousers', his energy is infectious. What's your favourite Madness hit?
